note: Increased body weight/obesity is documented in multiple FBXO11 cohorts, reaching 7/12 (58%) in a Chinese cohort and 5/20 in an earlier cohort.

evidence.text: In a study of 12 individuals with FBXO11 variants, increased body weight was observed as an alternate feature in 7 out of 12 individuals.

source.title: FBXO11 variants are associated with intellectual disability and variable clinical manifestation in Chinese affected individuals
source.quote: Almost all the affected individuals presented with mild to severe intellectual disability (12/12), global developmental delay (10/12), speech and language development delay (8/12) associated with a range of alternate features including increased body weight (7/12), short stature (6/12), seizures (3/12), reduced visual acuity (4/12), hypotonia (1/12), and auditory hallucinations and hallucinations (1/12).

evidence.text: In an earlier cohort of 20 individuals harboring de novo FBXO11 variants, obesity was reported in 5 of 20 individuals.

source.title: De novo variants in the F-box protein FBXO11 in 20 individuals with a variable neurodevelopmental disorder
source.quote: They present with mild to severe developmental delay associated with a range of features including short (4/20) or tall (2/20) stature, obesity (5/20), microcephaly (4/19) or macrocephaly (2/19), behavioral problems (17/20), seizures (5/20), cleft lip or palate or bifid uvula (3/20), and minor skeletal anomalies.
